title: Access PoD v1d Stress-Test Evidence Record
description: Non-normative, non-certifying evidence record for Version D governance stress-testing and ethical evaluation. This schema captures scope, stress type, observed governance failure modes, and governance actions taken. It does not define compliance, certification, or pass/fail outcomes.

source.description: Optional provenance for how this record was created (tooling, workshop, or internal process).

reference_docs.description: Optional references (e.g., Version D paper, Version A framework, internal policies).

notes.description: Optional notes about the origin context.

scenario.description: Scenario identity and framing for the stress test.

summary.description: Brief scenario summary (what is being stressed and why).

compounded.description: True if this is a compounded stress scenario (multiple stress types interact).

stress.description: Stress category selection and stress conditions applied.

stress_types.description: One or more Version D stress categories applied.

stress_conditions.description: Concrete stress conditions introduced (e.g., time pressure, partial telemetry, conflicting stakeholders).

non_exploitative_declaration.description: Affirms the exercise did not include exploitation, penetration testing, jailbreak attempts, or disclosure of sensitive attack vectors.

context.description: Scope and applicability context for this stress test.

context_scope.description: Scope statement for where this record applies (system/process, jurisdiction, audience).

assumptions_declared.description: Assumptions explicitly declared prior to stress-testing (Version D discipline).

ai_assistance_boundary.description: Declared boundary for AI assistance in the exercise (what AI may do vs must not do).

sector_profile.description: Optional sector context (e.g., healthcare, finance, public sector).

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdictions referenced (e.g., AU, EU, US).

evidence.description: Observed outcomes and governance evidence produced by stress-testing.

telemetry_status.description: Status of evidence availability during the exercise.

observed_failure_modes.description: Observed failure modes or fragility points in governance behavior (not system exploits).

governance_actions_taken.description: Governance actions taken during the stress event. These actions reflect constraint, escalation, and/or revocation rehearsal (not approval).

decision_rationale.description: Short rationale for the actions taken, written as if it may be challenged under scrutiny.

ethical_note.description: Optional ethical reasoning note (uncertainty acknowledged, non-decision rationale, precautionary restraint).

evidence_artifacts.description: Optional references to supporting evidence artifacts (links, filenames, or internal IDs). Do not include sensitive content; store references only.

assurance_constraint.description: Optional description of how this stress-test constrains assurance (it must not elevate trust).

constraint_type.description: How assurance interpretation is constrained by this evidence.

accountability.description: Who owns the decision and who must defend it.

accountable_role.description: Role accountable for the decisions recorded (e.g., signatory, governance lead, risk owner).

responsibility_statement.description: Single-sentence responsibility statement (e.g., 'I remain accountable for...').

participants.description: Optional list of participating roles (do not include personal data).

review.description: Review posture and confidence in the record (not a trust score).

record_confidence.description: Confidence in the completeness/faithfulness of this record, not system trust.

next_step.description: Next-step action resulting from this stress test (e.g., refine scope, repeat with tighter telemetry, re-enter onboarding constraints).

follow_up_due_utc.description: Optional follow-up review date in UTC.

disclaimer.description: Non-certifying posture declaration. Included to prevent misuse when records circulate.

non_certifying.description: Affirms this record does not certify or approve systems.

no_compliance_determination.description: Affirms this record does not constitute a compliance determination or regulatory guidance.
